###1.0 clean dataset, combine EPC ratings and domestic CO2 emission dataset
```{r}
library(readr)     
library(dplyr)    
library(stringr)    
library(janitor)   
library(sf)


# ----read data ----
domestic <- read_csv("domestic_co2_2023.csv")
epc_rating <- read_csv("rq1_panel.csv")
geo_sf <-  st_read("Local_Authority_Districts_May_2024_Boundaries_UK_BFC_-6788913184658251542.geojson")


domestic <- domestic %>% clean_names()
epc_rating <- epc_rating %>% clean_names()


# domestic: region, ladcode, year, mid_year_pop_1000, area_km2, territorial_emission_kt
# rq1:      ladcode, year, urbanity, co2_per_1000p, t_co2, pop_1000, pct_E ... pct_D

domestic <- domestic %>%
  mutate(
    ladcode = as.character(ladcode),
    year    = as.integer(year)
  )

epc_rating <- epc_rating %>%
  mutate(
    ladcode = as.character(ladcode),
    year    = as.integer(year)
  )

epc_2023 <- epc_rating |>
  filter(year == 2023) |>
  distinct(ladcode, year, .keep_all = TRUE)

epc_2023 <- epc_2023 %>% distinct()




merged_2023 <- domestic |>
  left_join(epc_2023, by = c("ladcode", "year"))

# --- 5) （可选）融合/统一含义相同的列 ---
merged_2023 <- merged_2023 |>
  mutate(
    # 人口：优先 rq1 的 pop_1000，缺则用 domestic 的 mid_year_pop_1000
    pop_1000_merged = coalesce(pop_1000, mid_year_pop_1000),
    # 总排放：domestic 的 territorial_emission_kt(千吨) 转为 吨，与 rq1 的 t_co2 统一
    t_co2_from_domestic = territorial_emission_kt * 1000,
    t_co2_merged = coalesce(t_co2, t_co2_from_domestic)
  )


no_match_summary <- merged_2023 |>
  mutate(has_rq1 = if_else(is.na(urbanity) & is.na(co2_per_1000p) & is.na(t_co2), 0L, 1L)) |>
  count(has_rq1, name = "n_rows")
print(no_match_summary)

unmatched_keys <- merged_2023 |>
  filter(is.na(urbanity) & is.na(co2_per_1000p) & is.na(t_co2)) |>
  distinct(ladcode, year)
print(head(unmatched_keys, 10))

cols_to_drop <- c("territorial_emission_kt", "t_co2_from_domestic")

merged_2023 <- merged_2023 |>
  select(-any_of(cols_to_drop))

# 2) 合并重复行：同一 ladcode（建议也包含 year，以防以后有多年份）
merged_2023_clean <- merged_2023 |>
  distinct(ladcode, year, .keep_all = TRUE)

# 3) 可选：检查是否还有重复
dup_check <- merged_2023_clean |>
  count(ladcode, year, name = "n") |>
  filter(n > 1)
print(dup_check)  # 正常应为空


write_csv(merged_2023_clean, "merged_panel_domestic_2023_clean.csv")


```


### 2.0 EPC_panel for autocorrelation is ready
```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(janitor)
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(sfdep)     # 用于 (双变量) 局部 Moran
library(tmap)
set.seed(2023)

# 1. read in saved dataset in last step
epc_path <- "epc_panel.csv"

epc <- read_csv(epc_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(ladcode = as.character(ladcode),
         year    = as.integer(year))

epc <- epc |>
  mutate(
    pct_efg   = pct_e + pct_f + pct_g,
    pct_abcd  = pct_a + pct_b + pct_c + pct_d,
    pct_bcd   = pct_b + pct_c + pct_d
  )

library(dplyr)
geo_sf <- geo_sf %>%
  rename(ladcode = LAD24CD)

g <- geo_sf |> left_join(epc, by = "ladcode")
g_panel <- g |>
  select(ladcode, co2_per_1000p, urbanity,pct_efg, geometry, pct_bcd,)


```


```{r}
# Using KNN (k=4) get rid of islands
# 1. 构建 kNN (k = 4) 空间权重
coords <- st_coordinates(st_centroid(st_geometry(g_panel)))
nb <- knn2nb(knearneigh(coords, k = 4))
lw <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W")

# 2. 创建布尔索引，标记有效 LAD（co2 与 epc 都非 NA）
valid <- !is.na(g_panel$co2_per_1000p) & !is.na(g_panel$pct_efg)

# 3. 提取标准化变量（仅对有效 LAD）
y <- scale(g_panel$co2_per_1000p[valid])[,1]
x <- scale(g_panel$pct_efg[valid])[,1]

# 4. 构建有效 LAD 子集的空间权重
nb_sub <- spdep::subset.nb(nb, subset = valid)
lw_sub <- nb2listw(nb_sub, style = "W")

lag_x <- spdep::lag.listw(lw_sub, x, zero.policy = TRUE)




```


### 3.0 calculate Global Bivariate Moran's I
```{r}
# lag(EPC)
Wyx <- lag.listw(lw_sub, x)

# 计算 Global Bivariate Moran’s I
I_bv <- sum(y * Wyx) / sum(y^2)

# Monte Carlo p 值（置换 EPC）
nsim <- 999
I_perm <- replicate(nsim, {
  x_perm <- sample(x)
  Wyx_perm <- lag.listw(lw_sub, x_perm)
  sum(y * Wyx_perm) / sum(y^2)
})

# p 值
pval <- (sum(abs(I_perm) >= abs(I_bv)) + 1) / (nsim + 1)

# 输出结果
cat(sprintf("✅ Global Bivariate Moran's I: %.4f | Monte Carlo p-value: %.4f\n", I_bv, pval))

```

### 4.0 Bivariate Lisa cluster map
```{r}
# 1. 标准化变量
library(sfdep)
library(spdep)

# kNN (k=4) 邻接
coords <- st_coordinates(st_centroid(st_geometry(g_panel)))
nb <- knn2nb(knearneigh(coords, k = 4))

# 有效观测（两变量都不缺）
valid <- !is.na(g_panel$co2_per_1000p) & !is.na(g_panel$pct_efg)

# 子集 nb 与变量（注意：subset.nb 需要逻辑向量）
nb_sub <- spdep::subset.nb(nb, subset = valid)

# 权重（行标准化 W）
wt_sub <- sfdep::st_weights(nb_sub, style = "W")

# 标准化后的变量（仅对有效单元）
y_std <- scale(g_panel$co2_per_1000p[valid])[,1]
x_std <- scale(g_panel$pct_efg[valid])[,1]


lisa <- sfdep::local_moran_bv(
  x  = y_std,           # CO2
  y  = x_std,           # EPC
  nb = nb_sub,
  wt = wt_sub,
)

# 生成聚类标签（High/Low by 0）
lw_sub <- spdep::nb2listw(nb_sub, style = "W")
lag_epc <- spdep::lag.listw(lw_sub, x_std)

cluster_sub <- dplyr::case_when(
  lisa$p_ii < 0.05 & y_std >= 0 & lag_epc >= 0 ~ "High-High",
  lisa$p_ii < 0.05 & y_std <  0 & lag_epc <  0 ~ "Low-Low",
  lisa$p_ii < 0.05 & y_std >= 0 & lag_epc <  0 ~ "High-Low",
  lisa$p_ii < 0.05 & y_std <  0 & lag_epc >= 0 ~ "Low-High",
  TRUE ~ "Not significant"
)

# 写回到完整 g_panel（无效位置填 NA）
g_panel$cluster <- NA_character_
g_panel$cluster[valid] <- cluster_sub


```


```{r}
# 必要包
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(dplyr)
library(tmap)
set.seed(2023)

# 0) 前提：g_panel 已包含 geometry、co2_per_1000p、pct_efg
stopifnot(inherits(g_panel, "sf"),
          "co2_per_1000p" %in% names(g_panel),
          "pct_efg" %in% names(g_panel))

# 1) kNN(k=4) 权重（对所有单元构建）
coords <- st_coordinates(st_centroid(st_geometry(g_panel)))
nb_all <- knn2nb(knearneigh(coords, k = 6))
lw_all <- nb2listw(nb_all, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

# 2) 只在有效 LAD 上统计（两变量都非 NA）
valid <- !is.na(g_panel$co2_per_1000p) & !is.na(g_panel$pct_efg)
if (!any(valid)) stop("No valid LADs for analysis.")
nb_sub <- spdep::subset.nb(nb_all, subset = valid)
lw_sub <- nb2listw(nb_sub, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

# 3) 标准化变量（仅对有效 LAD）
y <- scale(g_panel$co2_per_1000p[valid])[, 1]  # CO2 (z-score)
x <- scale(g_panel$pct_efg[valid])[, 1]        # EPC (z-score)

# 4) 局部双变量 Moran：I_i = z(CO2)_i * sum_j w_ij * z(EPC)_j
Wyx   <- lag.listw(lw_sub, x, zero.policy = TRUE)
Ii    <- y * Wyx

# 5) Monte Carlo 置换检验（对 x 置换）
nsim <- 999
ge_count <- integer(length(y))
for (s in 1:nsim) {
  x_perm  <- sample(x)  # 仅在有效 LAD 内置换
  Wyx_p   <- lag.listw(lw_sub, x_perm, zero.policy = TRUE)
  Ii_perm <- y * Wyx_p
  ge_count <- ge_count + as.integer(abs(Ii_perm) >= abs(Ii))
}
p_raw <- (ge_count + 1) / (nsim + 1)
p_bh  <- p.adjust(p_raw, method = "BH")

# 6) 聚类分类（按 y 与 lag(x) 的正负 + p_BH<0.05）
lag_epc <- Wyx
co2_hilo <- ifelse(y >= 0, "High", "Low")
lag_hilo <- ifelse(lag_epc >= 0, "High", "Low")
cluster_sub <- ifelse(p_bh < 0.05 & co2_hilo=="High" & lag_hilo=="High", "High-High",
                ifelse(p_bh < 0.05 & co2_hilo=="Low"  & lag_hilo=="Low",  "Low-Low",
                ifelse(p_bh < 0.05 & co2_hilo=="High" & lag_hilo=="Low",  "High-Low",
                ifelse(p_bh < 0.05 & co2_hilo=="Low"  & lag_hilo=="High", "Low-High",
                       "Not significant"))))

# 7) 回写到完整 g_panel（无效置 NA）
g_panel$Ii_bv   <- NA_real_
g_panel$p_bv    <- NA_real_
g_panel$p_bv_bh <- NA_real_
g_panel$cluster <- NA_character_
g_panel$Ii_bv  [valid] <- Ii
g_panel$p_bv   [valid] <- p_raw
g_panel$p_bv_bh[valid] <- p_bh
g_panel$cluster[valid] <- cluster_sub

# 8) 快速可视化
tmap_mode("plot")
pal <- c("High-High"="#b2182b","Low-Low"="#2166ac",
         "High-Low"="#ef8a62","Low-High"="#67a9cf",
         "Not significant"="grey85")
tm_shape(g_panel) +
  tm_fill("cluster", palette = pal,
          title = "Bivariate LISA: CO₂ vs lag(EPC)\n(p adj. BH < 0.05)") +
  tm_borders(col = "grey40", lwd = 0.3) +
  tm_layout(legend.outside = TRUE)

```
